All supplied signals and evidence (SIG-G60-US-030; EV-G60-US-FB-G60-0740, EV-G60-US-FB-G60-1594, EV-G60-US-FB-G60-2989, EV-G60-US-FB-G60-1157, EV-G60-US-FB-G60-0782, EV-G60-US-ST-48) are from the US: multiple customer complaints and a US study (15% dissatisfied) show a US need, but no non‑US data are provided, so we can’t conclude whether the problem is limited to the US or is global.
suggested_change: Clarify scope: require equivalent on‑road usability trials in other target markets or state that the acceptance criterion applies only to the US.
